title: Read views and constant expressions
description: A string_view refers to character data without owning it. You can also compare functions that allow or require compile-time evaluation.

steps.description: count_vowels accepts a string_view and scans its characters. Each matching character increments n.
The function accepts the displayed string forms through views. substr creates a view of part of the character sequence.
The commented dangle example shows a view referring to a local string after that string's lifetime ends.
factorial uses constexpr, which permits compile-time evaluation. fibonacci uses consteval, which requires compile-time evaluation.
The constexpr variables request constant results from both functions. static_assert checks the displayed factorial condition during compilation.
